findings.evidence: template/docs/engineering/chatgpt-project-protocol.md:83–89 still defines fixation success through Issue/label read-back, and :229–233 stops immediately afterward. template/docs/engineering/task-intake.md.jinja:26–31 likewise omits membership confirmation. These template surfaces receive neither the membership gate nor the unconfirmed outcome added to the central docs. This contradicts the active delta at openspec/changes/requirement-project-membership/specs/managed-task-intake/spec.md:26 and the accepted managed-task-intake requirement that downstream agents share the updateable intake contract.
findings.summary: Downstream connected adapters retain the old fixation contract and can report success without confirmed Project membership.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/managed_project_status.py:421–435 requests Backlog for an unset Status, but the final read-back rejects only None; it never checks the expected Status required by design.md:7. A read-only in-memory probe of the exact function with current=None and final_status='Ready' returned success with status_initialized=True after requesting Backlog. Consequently, successful fixation can be reported without confirming the initialization required by the active delta at specs/managed-task-intake/spec.md:5.
findings.summary: Membership confirmation accepts a Status that contradicts the requested initialization.
